ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a circle, and at the center of the circle there are three rays dividing the circular angle into three central angle regions. The small angle label at the upper left is (3x)°, the angle label at the lower left is 90°, and the larger angle label on the right side is (7x+10)°. Then reason: These three central angles surround the same center of the circle, and together they are exactly one full turn of 360°. Therefore set up the equation: (3x) + 90 + (7x + 10) = 360. Combining like terms gives 10x + 100 = 360, so 10x = 260, solving gives x = 26.
